description: This file defines the 'Field' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, representing the mathematical concept of a field and providing methods to access its additive and multiplicative identities as well as runtime class information.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Interface representing a mathematical field in the Commons Math library, parameterized by element type T.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns the additive identity element of the field.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative identity element of the field.

methods.name: getRuntimeClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime Class object representing the class of the field elements.
